info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Remember vocabulary, expressions, collocations related to the topics,  and techniques to perform well in IELTS tests

Apply Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing techniques learned to do well in IELTS tests
+ Listening: predict, listen for gists or details, take notes
+ Reading: predict, skim, scan, guess word meanings, distinguish between beliefs and arguments, find keywords
+ Writing: understand visual information, choose and report main features, write a paragraph to describe a trend or process, write a complete academic essay (structure and content)
+ Speaking: sound like native speakers (pronunciation and intonation),  expand ideas to talk about a topic, talk about the causes and effects of an issue
Analyze contents and structures of different tasks at IELTS band 6.5-7.0
Evaluate the ability to apply techniques learned, use complex language well and have a good command of English
Deliver effective test performance in the IELTS exam.
